g.text: Anatomy of one NVL72 compute tray (schematic, 1U, top view)
Vera Rubin NVL72 tray (H2 2026): what changes
REAR EDGE - blind-mate connectors into the rack
MIDDLE - two superchip boards (cold plate on every GPU and CPU)
FRONT EDGE - I/O and service side

text.tspan: 2 Vera CPUs (88 custom Olympus cores, up to 1.5 TB LPDDR5X each)

ConnectX-9 SuperNICs (1.6 Tb/s per GPU) + BlueField-4 DPU
cable-free, hose-free, fanless tray: 100% liquid cooled
NVIDIA claims assembly in ~5 minutes vs ~2 hours
= 1.8 TB/s per GPU into the spine
~50 V DC in from power shelves
